lines.text: The seventh day is a Sabbath of complete rest, and Passover begins at twilight on the fourteenth day.
After entering the land, Israel brings the priest a sheaf of firstfruits, and he burns it before the LORD.
On the first day of the seventh month, Israel has a day of rest announced by clashing cymbals.
The Feast of Tabernacles begins on the fifteenth day of the seventh month and runs seven days.
